notes: The booklet genuinely builds five separate models from one set (tall robot pp3-23, wheeled robot pp24-47, dog pp48-57, rover with excavator arm / binocular module pp58-83, red-ball robot pp84-104). They share no parts, so the graph has five disconnected groups by design (plus repeat copies attached inside the dog and rover); no edges join separate models.

Counts reconciled with the parts pages: the three 6213783 teal 1x3 bricks are rover step 9 and red-ball robot step 11 (x2); the two 6217660 teal 1x4 bricks are rover step 9 (x2); the wheeled-robot step 27 holed bricks are the two 4211541 (1x2 with holes) while step 7 uses the two 4211441 (1x4 with holes); Technic pins split into 8 short friction pins (4206482) and 7 long pins (4514553); both 6114580 and both 6114583 leg panels are placed (step 2 and steps 8/12).

Antenna pieces are kept as lego-73587 (black base) and lego-73737 (white base) exactly as printed on the parts page (p109, 2x each); these numbers are 5-digit and may be truncated element IDs, but they are the only identifiers the booklet gives, so they are kept rather than mapped to an unlisted catalogue part.
Remaining count uncertainty: one white 2x4/2x3 plate cannot be assigned uniquely from the small pictures, so 302101 / 302001 / 6104805 may be off by one between models.

Binocular module (rover step 34): the callout shows 2 lenses on the upper barrels and 2 on the lower mounts, so all 4 lenses are attached; page 83 shows two loose, which is how the module may be displayed.

Where the exact stud/pin an assembly attaches to cannot be read from the small step pictures, the nearest plausible joined pair was chosen. Ports are left null. Pin/axle joins are revolute where the picture shows a free pivot; stud joins are rigid and hand-removable.

Rover: the excavator arm and the binocular module are alternative builds on the same mounting position (page 83); both are included. Tall robot step 34 light sabres (b66, b67) are inserted into the gun end and shoulder joint; their exact socket is approximate.
